mcqs.question: Hul Diwas commemorates the Santal rebellion that began on which date?
mcqs.explanation: Hul Diwas is observed on June 30 and commemorates the Santal rebellion that began on June 30, 1855. November 15, 2000 is associated with the formation of Jharkhand, while 1925 and 2003 relate to other Santali developments.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Santal Hul is incorrect?
options: Sido and Kanhu Murmu were its leaders, and the rebellion was proclaimed at Bhognadih.
The rebellion occurred in Damin-i-Koh, a tract along the Rajmahal Hills in eastern Jharkhand.
In Santali, Hul means rebellion or movement.
Sido and Kanhu Murmu proclaimed the rebellion at Ranchi.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement places the proclamation at Ranchi. Sido and Kanhu Murmu proclaimed the rebellion at Bhognadih; Damin-i-Koh was the tract along the Rajmahal Hills, and Hul means rebellion or movement in Santali.
